verdict.rationale: Notte's own marketing claims "Live View & Replays" with session playback, and the docs expose a live ViewerUrl and frame the platform as a place to "debug" workflows. That is only a thin first-party mention of replay, with no documentation of how recordings work or how they support debugging a failed run. Missing for 10: documented video replay retrieval for completed or failed runs, screenshot capture per step, a step-by-step action timeline or trace view, in-depth docs on replay debugging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
